command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd inventory-api >/dev/null; then useradd --system --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /usr/sbin/nologin --comment 'Inventory API service' inventory-api; fi
if ! getent passwd batchworker >/dev/null; then useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash --comment 'Batch worker account' batchworker; fi
cat > /usr/local/libexec/inventory-api <<'PY_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import json
import os
import platform
from http import HTTPStatus
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "inventory-api/1.0"

    def _reply(self, status, payload):
        body = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8") + b"\n"
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            self._reply(HTTPStatus.OK, {"service": "inventory-api", "status": "ok"})
        elif self.path == "/inventory":
            self._reply(HTTPStatus.OK, {
                "hostname": platform.node(),
                "kernel": platform.release(),
                "machine": platform.machine(),
            })
        else:
            self._reply(HTTPStatus.NOT_FOUND, {"error": "not found"})

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        print("%s - %s" % (self.address_string(), fmt % args), flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler).serve_forever()
PY_EOF
chown root:root /usr/local/libexec/inventory-api
chmod 0755 /usr/local/libexec/inventory-api
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service <<'UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory API
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory-api
Group=inventory-api
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/libexec/inventory-api
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectHome=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
LockPersonality=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT_EOF
chown root:root /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service
chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service
cat > /etc/security/limits.d/50-batchworker.conf <<'LIMIT_EOF'
# Per-process virtual address-space cap for the batch worker account (KiB).
batchworker soft as 131072
batchworker hard as 131072
LIMIT_EOF
chown root:root /etc/security/limits.d/50-batchworker.conf
chmod 0644 /etc/security/limits.d/50-batchworker.conf
/usr/bin/python3 -m py_compile /usr/local/libexec/inventory-api
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service

getent passwd inventory-api
getent passwd batchworker
stat -c '%n %a %U:%G' /usr/local/libexec/inventory-api /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service /etc/security/limits.d/50-batchworker.conf

set -eu
out=/tmp/batchworker-limit-test.out
rm -f "$out"
umask 077
runuser -u batchworker -- /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import resource,time,sys; print("uid=%d gid=%d rlimit_as=%s" % (resource.os.getuid(), resource.os.getgid(), resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS)), flush=True); expected=False

 expected=True; print("allocation_failed=MemoryError", flush=True); time.sleep(4)
sys.exit(0 if expected else 1)' >"$out" 2>&1 &
test_pid=$!
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 20 ]; do
  grep -q 'allocation_failed=MemoryError' "$out" 2>/dev/null && break
